title: metalens-information-design: Information-Optimized Design of Color Metalenses without a Prescribed Phase

creators.name: Park, Hyoseok
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Chungnam National University

creators.name: Park, Yeonsang
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Chungnam National University

description: Code accompanying the manuscript "Information-Optimized Design of Color Metalenses without a Prescribed Phase": a rigorous full-Jones forward model for a single-layer metalens in front of an RGGB colour filter array, the target-information objective, the projected width-map optimizer, three published width maps with a reproduction script, and a local web console for running the optimization.
